Metadata.title: Warif | Understand your cycle
Metadata.description: Warif is a private, safe Arabic women's wellness app for tracking the menstrual cycle and daily health, with medically reviewed content and a supportive community.

Common.tagline: Understand your cycle. Care for yourself. You are not alone.

Landing.heroEyebrow: Your calm space to care for yourself
Landing.heroSubtitle: Warif is a calm space to understand your cycle and daily health, with real privacy and a safe Arabic community.
Landing.feature1Body: Log your cycle, symptoms, mood, energy and sleep in under thirty seconds.
Landing.feature2Body: Understand your personal patterns through a clear calendar and predictions shown as estimates, not certainties.
Landing.feature3Body: Read trustworthy Arabic health articles with the reviewer's name, sources and last update date.
Landing.feature4Body: Share your experience in a supportive, moderated women's community without revealing your real identity.
Landing.privacyTitle: Your privacy is a core feature
Landing.privacyBody: We separate your identity data from your health data, never sell your data, and never use it for targeted ads. Export and deletion are always available.
Landing.disclaimerBody: Warif is a tracking, education and support tool, not a diagnostic or treatment tool. All cycle and ovulation dates are fallible estimates and must not be used as contraception.
Landing.heroImageAlt: Illustration of three Arab women sitting in a calm space, one holding a phone showing the Warif app.
Landing.privacyImageAlt: Illustration of a calm woman using her phone, surrounded by soft botanical leaves.

Today.title: My day with Warif
Today.subtitle: A calm glimpse of your phase today, shown as an estimate.
Today.estimateNote: These are estimates based on the averages you entered and may change. The more you log, the better the prediction.
Today.notContraception: The fertile window is not a contraception method, and this is not medical advice.
Today.privacyNote: Your data is stored only on your device and is never sent to any server.

CycleSetup.title: Set up your cycle
CycleSetup.intro: We only need three details to show your daily glimpse. You can change them anytime.
CycleSetup.lastPeriodLabel: When did your last period start?
CycleSetup.cycleLengthLabel: How many days does your cycle usually last?
CycleSetup.periodLengthLabel: How many days does your period usually last?
CycleSetup.errorFuture: The date cannot be in the future

Phase.menstruationStory: Your body is starting a new cycle. It's natural to want more rest and to feel lower energy.
Phase.menstruationTip: Give yourself rest, warmth and plenty of water.
Phase.follicularStory: Energy often rises gradually after your period ends, and mood and focus may improve.
Phase.follicularTip: A good time for movement and activities you enjoy.
Phase.ovulationStory: Your cycle is nearing its midpoint. You may notice small changes in energy or discharge.
Phase.ovulationTip: Listen to your body and stay well hydrated.
Phase.lutealStory: Before your next period, mood may shift or some symptoms may appear. This is common and passes.
Phase.lutealTip: Enough sleep and a calm routine can help a lot.

CheckIn.title: Daily check-in
CheckIn.subtitle: A few seconds to log your day.
CheckIn.privacyNote: Your check-ins are stored only on your device and never sent to any server.
CheckIn.imageAlt: Illustration of a woman relaxing and logging her day in the Warif app.

WeekSummary.title: Last 7 days
WeekSummary.empty: No check-ins yet. Log your day to see your patterns.

Calendar.title: Cycle calendar
Calendar.subtitle: A monthly view coloured by phase. Upcoming days are estimates.
Calendar.needSetup: Set up your cycle details first to see the calendar.
Calendar.estimateNote: Upcoming days are estimates that may change and are not a contraception method.

Onboarding.imageAlt: Illustration of a calm woman using her phone, surrounded by soft botanical leaves.
Onboarding.step1Body: Log your cycle, symptoms and mood in seconds, and understand your patterns calmly.
Onboarding.step2Body: We separate your health data from your identity, never sell your data, and export/deletion are always available.
Onboarding.step3Body: Share your experience in a supportive, moderated women's space without revealing your identity.
